title: Mid-American Conference appeals to have Western Michigan recognized as winner of game against Michigan

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mid-American Conference appeals to have Western Michigan recognized as winner of game against Michigan
sources.description: Western Michigan's last-second loss to Michigan on a Hail Mary after a controversial replay review granted the Wolverines an extra play was the biggest story of the college football weekend, but Western Michigan's conference isn't ready to let it go just yet.
